subject.title: Create Claw agent and root install record

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this consent-bound, SQLite-backed experimental `claws add` lifecycle in core as part of the stacked RFC direction?
rationale: The patch is a new public CLI and persistent-state feature whose ownership and staged integration cannot be settled by correctness review alone, particularly while its predecessor remains open.

options.title: Sponsor the staged core lifecycle
options.body: Confirm that the experimental core lifecycle is the intended product direction, then require proof tied to the live head plus fresh-install and upgrade recovery coverage.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep this branch open but defer review until the predecessor and the intended core-versus-extension ownership are decided.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged core lifecycle
recommendation.body: Confirm that the experimental core lifecycle is the intended product direction, then require proof tied to the live head plus fresh-install and upgrade recovery coverage.
